visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a split-screen presentation featuring a male with dark hair and glasses sitting on a tan leather couch. He is dressed in two distinct styles: a blue patterned shirt and a black oversized hoodie with a backwards cap. He holds a smartphone, engaging in a dialogue with his alternate self in a bright, minimalist indoor setting with white walls and soft ambient light. (2) The scene transitions to a high-energy lobby environment where the man, now wearing a brown blazer, points enthusiastically toward a large, glowing i-Ride wall sign and Attack on Titan promotional displays. He holds a red and black commemorative ticket close to the camera. Later, he stands beside a life-sized anime character cardboard cutout, gesturing at its height with a playful expression. (3) A staff member in a white uniform shirt and bowtie leads the man through a dark doorway labeled 動漫飛行. Inside, he enters a bright room equipped with a green screen backdrop where he joins three companions—two women in casual tops and another man—to pose for a group photograph. A monitor nearby displays their processed photo integrated with a thematic digital background. (4) The setting shifts to the interior of a flight simulator theater characterized by purple and blue neon lighting and industrial metal textures. The man is seen sitting in a row of suspended chairs, demonstrating the process of securing a heavy-duty seatbelt with a prominent red metallic buckle. The background shows other empty simulator seats and technical equipment mounted on the ceiling. (5) A montage of 3D animation clips from the Attack on Titan series plays, depicting vast mountainous landscapes, urban warfare, and giant creatures. These are intercut with shots of the man in the simulator seat, his hair tossed by strong wind effects and his face contorted in excitement. Visible wisps of white smoke or mist drift across the frame during the most intense action sequences. (6) Following the simulator experience, the man remains in the suspended seat, speaking directly to the camera with animated facial expressions and broad hand gestures. The lighting is focused and warm, emphasizing his reactions of awe and satisfaction. The metallic frame of the simulator chair is clearly visible in the foreground, framing his upper body against the dark theater background. (7) The final segment takes place at a merchandise counter, displaying various collectible items like acrylic stands, keychains, and character cards. The man stands next to a mannequin dressed in a signature green hooded anime cloak. He holds up a promotional brochure and points directly at the lens, standing near a brick-textured wall with signage as a final invitation to viewers.

The medium-paced speech includes natural breaths and informal inflections. A light, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM with a gentle rhythmic pulse plays in the background. The ambient noise floor is extremely low, typical of a controlled indoor recording environment. (2) A prominent transition occurs as the BGM shifts to a high-energy pop-rock track with a driving drum kit and distorted electric guitar (approx. 128 BPM). The primary male voice becomes significantly louder and more energetic, utilizing a wider pitch range and faster delivery. A sharp ding sound effect punctuates the start of the promotional narration, while background chatter from a lobby is faintly audible. (3) Technical sound effects dominate the next phase, including the metallic click of a heavy latch and the low-frequency rumble of a mechanical platform. The music transitions into a cinematic orchestral arrangement with booming percussion and tense string sections. Short bursts of broadband white noise simulate rushing air, while deep, synthesized impacts correspond to visual explosions. Distant Japanese anime vocal clips provide atmospheric depth. (4) High-arousal vocalizations from the main speaker, including shouts of excitement and laughter, are layered over the intense orchestral BGM. The sound of liquid spray or mist dispersion is audible as a short, hissy burst. The ambient floor carries the reverberation of a large enclosed theater space. Musical tension builds through rising melodic lines and increased percussive density before a sudden, brief silence for comedic effect. (5) The final phase features a hyper-dense, fast-paced narration characteristic of a promotional advertisement. The speech rate is high with minimal pauses. Short, melodic keyboard jingles accompany the mention of specific products. The driving BGM continues at a consistent volume until a final whoosh transition and a resonant, low-end musical stinger mark the end of the recording, followed by a crisp silence.
